page_title: RSO 0-1 RAY | Real Sociedad v Rayo Vallecano 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
90+2' The foul by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Guzman.
90+1' Rayo Vallecano are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
89' Jose Guzman interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).
87' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Andrei Ratiu feeds Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
84' Real Sociedad couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
80' Here comes a substitution. Brais Mendez is given a rest as he is replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
80' Substitution. Ander Barrenetxea makes his way off the pitch and Jon Karrikaburu (Real Sociedad) comes on as his replacement.
77' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Jorge de Frutos will be replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
77' Alemao will be replaced by Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).
74' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
73' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Guzman has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
72' Real Sociedad fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
71' Inigo Perez is forced to make a change. Pathe Ciss is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jozhua Vertrouwd (Rayo Vallecano).
69' The game is interrupted now, Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
69' The attendance is 31189.
68' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
67' Jose Guzman blows for a foul after Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Isi Palazon.
65' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
64' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Real Sociedad win a corner.
64' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the long-range free kick from Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
62' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is booked.
61' Sergio Francisco prepares a substitution. Goncalo Guedes is replaced by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
61' Substitution. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) in, Carlos Soler out.
61' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Jose Guzman lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
60' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

60' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
59' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Jose Guzman signals a set piece.
59' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

59' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players. Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.
55' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul.

54' What a sweet touch by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
54' A spell of possession for Real Sociedad in an attempt to control the game.
52' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
51' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) brings an opponent down and Jose Guzman interrupts the game.
50' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
49' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.

49' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
49' The game is interrupted as Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is flagged offside.
47' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). Jose Guzman saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
46' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' Inigo Perez has made a change at the break. Fran Perez has come on in place of Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Jose Guzman has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' The players claim that Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
42' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
41' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
41' A corner kick by Real Sociedad is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano).
40' A long ball forward to Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is intercepted. Corner kick. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity.
40' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

39' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
39' 51:49 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
38' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
35' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar.
35' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
33' Some patient build-up play from Rayo Vallecano as they look to unlock the defence.
30' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
28' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
24' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) meets a cross inside the box, but Alex Remiro wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
23' CHANCE! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a shot towards Augusto Batalla, who produces an excellent reflex save.
22' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) passes the ball onto Sergio Gomez, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
21' Some great controlled play and passing from Real Sociedad. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
17' The referee blows his whistle as Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in his challenge.

11' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jose Guzman with no other option than to blow for a foul.
10' Rayo Vallecano keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
9' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano. Good work from Rayo Vallecano as they win a corner.
7' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
5' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
3' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Guzman saw the whole situation.
2' Real Sociedad string together a series of short passes.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Jose Guzman will supervise the game today.
